title: ASTM D5150 - Standard Test Method for Hiding Power of Architectural Paints in the Field
relevance: Field protocols for checking paint opacity, color consistency, and background bleed-through under artificial and natural light.

title: Master Painters Institute (MPI) - Maintenance Repainting and Acceptance Standards
relevance: Standardized visual inspection distances (1.5 to 2 meters under normal diffused lighting), acceptable surface defect thresholds, and gloss uniformity.

title: Kuwait Society of Engineers (KSE) - Interior Finishing Handover Checklists
relevance: Formal handover checklist for residential villas in Kuwait: gypsum joints, skirting caulking, door frame transitions, and final payment release criteria.

title: Kuwait Ministry of Public Works (MPW) - General Specifications for Building Works: Section 12 (Painting)
relevance: Governmental acceptance standards for primer thickness, surface waviness tolerances, and edge sharpness around electrical fittings and fixtures.
